comparison.objective: Match two size-coded glass stoppers to their flasks and seat both tapered joints; candidate adjusts and locks an articulated gripper.
comparison.physical_skill: Size selection and precise tapered insertion of fragile parts versus bimanual tool use and torque control on threaded hardware.
comparison.success_condition: Both correct stoppers seated within tight pose tolerances, glassware released and stable for one second; wrong-size insertion, tipping, or loss fails.
comparison.reason: Taper matching and insertion have no meaningful ability-level overlap with preserving a stop setting under jam-nut reaction.
